name: @whytide/ai
description: The Mastra setup, the task registry, the eval runner

scripts.test: pnpm generate && tsc -b && APP_ENV=test PROVIDER_LLM=fake node --test tests/*.test.ts
scripts.test:tenancy: pnpm generate && tsc -b && APP_ENV=test PROVIDER_LLM=fake node --test tests/tenancy.test.ts
scripts.eval: pnpm generate && tsc -b && APP_ENV=test node --env-file-if-exists=../../../.env.local evals/run.ts
scripts.generate: pnpm -F providers generate && pnpm -F db generate && node registry/generate.ts
